definitions.gloss: deluxe edition; luxury version; premium edition
definitions.explanation: A higher-quality, more elaborately produced version of a book, product, or service, typically featuring additional content, better materials, or special packaging at a higher price.

examples.japanese: {豪華版|ごうかばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: The deluxe edition comes with bonuses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧{豪華版|ごうかばん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れた→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: The limited deluxe edition sold out immediately.

examples.japanese: {通常版|つうじょうばん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{豪華版|ごうかばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧{豪華版|ごうかばん}にした。
examples.english: I was torn between the standard and deluxe editions, but ended up going with the deluxe.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧ (gorgeous/luxurious) + {版|ばん} (edition/version). Used for books, manga, DVDs, video games, and other products released in both standard and premium formats.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧{豪華版|ごうかばん}: limited deluxe edition
- {豪華版|ごうかばん}⟦ボックス→ボックス：30522_bokkusu⟧: deluxe box set
- ⟦{初回|しょかい}→初回：11780_shokai⟧{豪華版|ごうかばん}: first-run deluxe edition
- {豪華版|ごうかばん}⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧: deluxe edition bonus items

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {通常版|つうじょうばん}: standard edition — the regular, lower-priced version
- ⟦{普及版|ふきゅうばん}→普及版：24869_fukyuuban⟧: popular/affordable edition — emphasizes wide availability and lower price
- {特装版|とくそうばん}: special edition — focuses on unique packaging or binding
- ⟦{限定版|げんていばん}→限定版：17391_genteiban⟧: limited edition — emphasizes scarcity rather than luxury
